triplet: Flip a coin for The Rib-Breaker, and if heads, the fall breaks your ribs.
The Youngest Brother has been losing, so the spirit of his father begins to mutiny against this servitude.
The Tyrant Brother forces the boy to attack the strongest, and would as lief he break his neck as his finger.
The Old Servant has lost his teeth in your service, so sacrifice him to fully heal another character.
Whenever The Exile takes adversity from the environment, he finds books in running brooks.
As a weasel sucks eggs, The Melancholy Sad-Sack sucks melancholy out of a song to restore his own ego.
When The Weeping Stag is losing, his velvet friends abandon him, so sweep on, fat and greasy citizens.
The Motley Fool confuses the enemy, so they must speak in rhymes, and wise men do foolishly.
Ganymede switches strength and wit at will, a counterfeit man with a swashing and martial outside.
Aliena is content to share the play with Ganymede, but she cannot go no further.
The Shepherd earns gold as a true laborer, and he will eat what he earns and wear what he gets.
The God of Marriage must make conclusion of these strange events, and the most pairs wins.
Ill met by moonlight, The Fairy King is invisible and will overhear your conference.
The Fairy Queen cannot attack any character as beautiful as an ass.
The Hobgoblin will randomize the next attack, and Lord, what fools these targets are.
The Changeling Boy causes a custody dispute, and she never had a sweeter changeling.
The Ass-Head has the confidence, not the intelligence, so he is immune to insults.
Read the prologue of The Carpenter aloud, and if you stumble, you played it like a child on a recorder.
The Lion is no such thing, just a man with a gentle roar, as other men are.
The Wall blocks all attacks, but through the chink poor souls are content to whisper.
The more you spurn The Tall One, the more she buffs you, so use her but as your spaniel.
The Short One is but little, but against the taller she is a fierce vixen.
With The Purple Flower on sleeping eye-lids laid, you must defend the next played, regardless of team.
When The Moon is waning, all magic will end, but the dog is my dog.
The Bachelor deals paper bullets based on the words in your insult, and will live a bachelor.
Swear you love The Lady Tongue and suffer the burn, because she had rather hear her dog bark at a crow.
The Bastard creates a rumor that prevents two from teaming up, because he is a plain-dealing villain.
The Drunkard will fabricate evidence of a vile encounter, but he has drunk to-day.
The Constable can only succeed at the wrong task, O that he had been writ down an ass!
The Headborough is a good old man, sir, who will support Dogberry and add confusion by talking.
The Slandered Bride died defiled, but she does live, and returns fully healed.
Let her be secretly kept in, and The Friar's Plan will convert slander into guilt on the attacker.
With The Masked Ladies, which is which? I am your husband, if you like.
The Penitent hangs an epitaph to mourn the death by slanderous tongues, and so gains attack.
Benedick challenges Claudio to The Challenge and does not jest, so the loser loses the weapon.
Born under The Dancing Star, you resolve the merry war if both players are smiling.
Peace? The Prince of Cats hates the word, so attack him and he will strike back instantly.
Kill The Joker and you shall find him a grave man with a plague on all houses.
The Peacemaker will part fools and their swords, but you know not what you do.
You bite your thumb at us, sir? Then you must attack The Thumb-Biter in a civil brawl.
With The Lover it is either double or kill self, because he is fortune's fool!
It is too rash and too sudden, so The Saint will accelerate the game timer.
The Nurse will delay delivery of the message, and Lord, how her head aches!
On The Rope Ladder you sneak into the enemy base without fighting, and the drudge toils in your delight.
Buy instant death poison from The Apothecary, because his poverty, but not his will, consents.
With The Sleeping Potion you appear dead, no warmth, no breath, until you wake up.
The Happy Dagger is happy, because this is its sheath, and there it will rust.
The Golden Statues end the game in a glooming peace where nobody wins and everyone feels sad.
The Mask is a mistaken identity, so a targeted attack will redirect to the adjacent.
